alex: quick sync - proposing a lightweight degraded-mode contract for the API gateway when edge pools are saturated. Goal: allow conservative fallbacks (cheap model, cached partial, or short-circuit) but keep semantics explicit for side-effecting routes. Thoughts?
maria: +1. how does the client know? header, trailer, control channel?
alex: two-part: immediate header X-RW-Edge-Degrade: level=soft; allow-fallback=true; prefer=cache and final trailer/header X-RW-Edge-Outcome: full|partial|fallback. client can act mid-stream.
ryan: careful with side-effects. don't silently fallback or hedge writes.
alex: agree. side-effect routes must opt-in in route config and require Idempotency-Key to allow fallback or hedging. no resume for side-effect routes.
linh: for cached partials, stream cached tokens and tag with X-RW-Edge-Outcome: partial; cached=true. optionally emit opaque resume handle if route allows.
maria: resume token pros/cons: useful for obtaining full run, but leaks and complexity.
alex: proposal: opaque X-RW-Resume-Handle only when route opt-in and origin model produced stable prefixes.
ryan: billing & metrics: emit edge_outcome and fallback_model tags so billing tracks cheaper vs full runs.
linh: add response_mode metric: normal|degraded|fallback|cached_partial for console rollups.
alex: impl sketch: ingress evaluates route policy (allowFallback, allowResume, sideEffectSafe). on saturation pick strategy based on prefer header and route config. attach X-RW-Edge-Degrade header immediately. stream tokens. include X-RW-Edge-Outcome trailer or final header and X-RW-Resume-Handle if applicable.
maria: hedging only for read-only endpoints. dedupe by request-id. no auto-retry for side-effecting ops unless Idempotency-Key present. bounded hedging window (e.g. 300ms).
linh: trailers not universal. send X-RW-Edge-Outcome as trailer when supported; otherwise as final header. also support Prefer: degrade=allow; fallback=cache,model from clients.
ryan: tests: integration test to ensure side-effect routes refuse fallback without Idempotency-Key; return 503+explanation and Retry-After when refusing. add fidelity evals for routes that opt-in.
deploy-bot: canary:edge-degrade-v1 deployed to prod-canary (10% ingress) at 2026-03-23T15:12Z :rocket:
alex: actions: alex->draft RFC with header/trailer spec and curl examples; linh->add metrics schema; ryan->hazard checklist and tests; maria->experiment plan and eval prompts. will open RFC PR this week.
maria: thanks, helpful.
ryan: +1.
linh: adding sample dashboards now.
